Momentum Engineering, Inc. Openings

ME00691-Content Developer 1

ME00691-Content Developer 1

Momentum Engineering, Inc. fosters an employee-centric culture. Our strength lies in our people. With a high percentage of employees holding advanced degrees in engineering, computer science, and related disciplines, we bring deep technical expertise to every mission. Our team includes professionals with security clearances and full-scope polygraphs, ensuring trusted, secure support for the most sensitive national security initiatives. Additionally, our workforce is equipped with industry-leading certifications, demonstrating a commitment to continuous learning and excellence. Most importantly, our exceptional employee retention rate reflects a culture of professional growth, mission focus, and dedication—ensuring long-term stability and expertise for our customers’ critical needs.

Job Summary

Seeking a Content Developer to support the development and maintenance of training content for mission-focused technical programs
This position is responsible for gathering source material, organizing content for course development, and helping ensure training products accurately reflect required subject matter and proficiency objectives
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in the applicable training content area and is able to translate operational, instructional, or technical knowledge into clear and effective course material

Primary Responsibilities

Gather raw content and source material for inclusion in assigned training courses
Organize and prepare content for development into instructional materials
Review course storyboards to ensure source content is accurately and appropriately represented
Work with instructional and technical personnel to support development and maintenance of training products
Help determine appropriate testing and assessment methods to ensure students demonstrate required proficiency
Review training content for completeness, technical accuracy, and alignment with intended learning objectives
Support updates to existing training materials as mission, technical, or instructional requirements change
Incorporate feedback from instructors, subject matter experts, and stakeholders into course content
Maintain familiarity with the technical or operational subject matter associated with assigned training
Support documentation and quality review activities associated with course development and maintenance

Required Qualifications

Must have active Top Secret/SCI clearance with NSA Full Scope Polygraph
Four (4) years of experience in the content area associated with the training being developed or maintained
Experience must include at least one of the following:
Computer Network Operations (CNO) operational duties
Development of related training
Instruction of related training
Mentoring or technical leadership in related content areas

Desired Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
Certifications relevant to the applicable training content area
Experience reviewing storyboards or instructional materials
Experience developing or supporting technical training for mission or operational environments
Strong written communication, organization, and attention to detail

Exempt hourly position.  11 paid holidays, minimum of 3 weeks PTO, company sponsored group medical plan, company paid dental, vision, life insurance, and STD/LTD plans.  Salary is dependent upon the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

The pay range for this role is:

90,000 - 100,000 USD per year (NBP)
